html:
Charlotte, NC, March 28, 2017 — Meridian Local, of Charlotte, NC has joined the National Council of Investigative Services & Security as a silver sponsor. NCISS is a national association that is made up of private investigators.

Meridian Local is now the go-to marketing company for all of its members as there are no other marketing companies aligned with this association at this time. Each state and local chapter fall under the national umbrella, which allows Meridian Local to educate a wider range of private investigators (PIs) across the country about online marketing.

NCISS and Meridian Local are equally excited about the partnership, and the wealth of knowledge each organization will obtain. “We look forward to attending trade show events and working with their members to increase awareness about online marketing for PIs,” said Brian Dickerson, Director of Strategic Partnerships at Meridian Local.

About Meridian Local

Meridian Local is a division of Meridian Media Group, Inc. one of the nation’s largest media companies. Meridian Local is a digital marketing and solutions organization that specializes in creating the total web presence small businesses need to make sure they reach their online audience. When clients partner with Meridian Local, they choose a team of industry-leading experts. Currently, Meridian Local serves 10,000+ clients on a month-to-month basis. Visit meridianlocal.com for more information.

About NCISS

Established in 1975, the founders of NCISS saw the need for security and investigation businesses to keep Congress and the Administration informed of their interests. They saw that without representation, the government would overlook them, or legislate against them. With that in mind, NCISS was born. For more information, visit nciss.org.
